items.user_turn: I'm trying to decide between two neighborhoods for our stay in Toronto. I really want a place that's near local eateries and shops so we can walk to dining and activities easily. Also, nighttime comfort is important to me—I’d prefer a quiet street or at least a softer interior courtyard to ensure a good night’s sleep. Plus, it would be great if the lodging is within a 10-minute walk to a subway station for public transport.
